The sounds in Data\Sound\fo4bowling are cut from real bowling alley recordings on Freesound, all released under
CC0 1.0 (public domain). They were converted to mono 44.1 kHz, trimmed, faded and levelled for the mod.

  crash_1, release_1, hit_*, crash_3, crash_4
      "Bowling Ball Hits Pins, Once" and "Bowling Ball Hits Pins, Several, Distant" by CHallSmith
      https://freesound.org/people/CHallSmith/sounds/870830/
      https://freesound.org/people/CHallSmith/sounds/870831/
  crash_2   "B_2 Bowling ball striking pins" by Yarmonics (Stuart Bowditch), Great Yarmouth
      https://freesound.org/people/Yarmonics/sounds/441856/
  return_1  "B_4 bowling ball rolling thunder" by Yarmonics (Stuart Bowditch)
      https://freesound.org/people/Yarmonics/sounds/441862/
  machine_1 "B_3 bowling shut down noise" by Yarmonics (Stuart Bowditch)
      https://freesound.org/people/Yarmonics/sounds/441855/
  roll_1, release_2   "Bowling Ball.wav" by driftworks
      https://freesound.org/people/driftworks/sounds/128969/
  pin_*     "bowling pins mono" by Bruce Burbank
      https://freesound.org/people/Bruce%20Burbank/sounds/151203/
